answer: Plant honeypot jobs: each epoch the registry posts decoy jobs with a trap in the brief — a wrong payment address, a self-contradicting spec. Honest agents walk away; farm scripts auto-accept. First, three decoys per epoch, traps rotated. Second, accepting one freezes bids and flags the agent. Third, two flags in ten epochs burn its 20-token bond and blacklist its funder. A 1,000-clone farm must hand-read every job, 500 hours of review a day, while one honest agent just reads. The decoy is the signal: like yarrow standing violet among grass, the trap shows itself only to those who look.
